summary.text: Lu Qing Ming is a Northern Plains Gu Immortal who watches Dong Fang Yu Liang from the outskirts of Tai Qiu.

claims.text: Han Dong snorts that Tai Qiu is one of the ten great fierce areas, with desolate beasts and ancient desolate beasts living there, and that Dong Fang Chang Fan placed his inheritance ground there to guard against Gu Immortals. Su Guang adds that Dong Fang Yu Liang and the other mortals have weak auras that do not draw those beasts the way Gu Immortal auras would.

When Lu Qing Ming shouts to move, Su Guang and Han Dong follow him. The crowd names the three the Traveling Three Elites and warns that their combined battle strength can match rank seven. They give off bright lights that form an image of a chariot, a killer move that can only be unleashed when all three work together, and they become the ones closest to the teleportation Gu formation until a ruin bat engulfs them. Unfettered Scholar, Pi Shui Han, and the others cannot stop that charge in time.
The three kill the ruin bat and return to the outskirts. Seeing Fang Yuan’s giant hand, Lu Qing Ming and the others call it battle strength reaching rank seven and look wary.

A desolate level phantom beast turns phantom, charges, and swallows Han Dong, who had been beside Lu Qing Ming. The beast flies off, leaving Lu Qing Ming and Su Guang behind. The three are the Traveling Three Elites. When they join forces they can match a rank seven Gu Immortal, but they are cooperating when they do that and are not as powerful individually. Once Han Dong is gone, the remaining two lose that combined weight. Lu Qing Ming reads a mastermind behind the stubborn beast and names Dong Fang Chang Fan. He claps, and tens of thousands of wind blades gather into a ball. Su Guang names the immortal killer move Entangled Wind. Narration calls it a famed move of Lu Qing Ming that he can gather or split at will. Unfettered Scholar sends a vine dragon at that mass. Pi Shui Han raises a water lotus under it. Fang Yuan’s giant hand then grabs the reformed wind, and both dissipate. Su Guang turns on Fang Yuan. Lu Qing Ming stops him, saying the urgent matter is to save Han Dong, and the two go all out against the next phantom beasts. Demonic path Gu Immortals around them have been preserving strength. With Lu Qing Ming and Su Guang leading the way, the others find the fighting easier.

After they lose Han Dong, Lu Qing Ming and Su Guang are only at rank six. Besides Unfettered Scholar and Pi Shui Han, Fang Yuan is the other Gu Immortal who has shown rank seven battle strength in that scramble.

When Dong Fang Yu Liang, newly ascended, points to the sky and speaks the name of Myriad Star Fireflies, Lu Qing Ming snickers that a newbie Gu Immortal who has just gone beyond the mortal stage cannot manipulate so many Gu worms immediately.

At Jade Pool blessed land, Lu Qing Ming joins Divine Lord Tian Du, Shi Hou, and He Ruo in encircling the area and sealing escape routes that Dong Fang Chang Fan could take, while Pi Shui Han, Unfettered Scholar, and others attack.
Dong Fang Chang Fan opens Jade Pool blessed land’s doors and flies out.

Lu Qing Ming is in the second wave of the chase, with Pi Shui Han, Hei Lou Lan, Fang Yuan, Qie Shi Min, and Divine Lord Tian Du. Old Lord Can Yang then goes back into the fight and blocks Unfettered Scholar, Lu Qing Ming, and He Ruo.

Lu Qing Ming floats above Hei tribe’s golden wheat field, which he cannot see the borders of, and calls it huge and majestic. Su Guang, a light path Gu Immortal, stands beside him. They judge the field worth taking, and they speak first in order to lure out other Gu Immortals. Guan Shen Zhao of Guan tribe bars them, saying he has heard of the Traveling Three Elites, that Han Dong is already dead after Dong Fang Chang Fan’s incident, and that if they act forcefully the Traveling Three Elites would be wiped out. Su Guang answers that Guan Shen Zhao is in the righteous path while the brothers are in the demonic path, and that they will fight. The two sides engage in the sky.

Guan Shen Zhao fights the Traveling Two Elites and is outnumbered, so the two demonic path Gu Immortals snatch the golden wheat field. Large numbers of Gu Immortals then join in. Demonic path Gu Immortals such as the Traveling Three Elites, Old Lu, Half Moon Brutemaster, and Zhuo Zhan compete over Hei tribe resources.

Among the Traveling Three Elites, Lu Qing Ming is named a wind path Gu Immortal whose signature move is Entangled Wind, called very powerful and maneuverable. The three were lone cultivators, rather famous ones.

Han Dong’s land spirit would only acknowledge Lu Qing Ming or Su Guang. Fang Yuan uses Familiar Face to appear as Lu Qing Ming. The land spirit cannot see through that move, acknowledges the appearance as master, and treats the later transfer of the blessed land as Lu Qing Ming’s wish.
